description: This file defines an interface called ServerRequestFactoryInterface within the PSR-HTTP Message standard. The interface declares a method for creating server request objects with specified HTTP method, URI, and server parameters.

classes.name: ServerRequestFactoryInterface
classes.description: Interface for creating server request instances according to PSR-HTTP standards. It requires implementing the createServerRequest method that constructs a request with specified method, URI, and server parameters.

methods.name: createServerRequest
methods.description: Creates a new server request with the given HTTP method, URI (or URI string), and optional server parameters.
